name: Winter Warrior
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [cold]; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect summoned ice elemental
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell summons a large ice elemental (a hulking brute of jagged ice and packed snow). It appears where the caster wishes and can act immediately. It does its best to defend the caster and attack his enemies. If the caster can communicate with the elemental, it can be instructed to take other actions. It obeys the caster to the best of its ability. (Ice elemental is a template to convert an earth elemental into an ice elemental.)

As with all summoned monsters, this ice elemental cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support it.
